answer: The wander counter is kept in anchor and ember reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3185 identities would post 2088 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
